So we use that.

Also fetal gender determination without medical qualification: That is "非法进行胎儿性别鉴定"? Under Chinese law, there is crime of "非法进行胎儿性别鉴定" (illegal fetal gender identification). So we need that offense.

Thus two offenses: 非法进行胎儿性别鉴定; 非法进行节育手术

Check if any other: maybe "非法行医" (practicing medicine without license). The facts: performed gender identification and abortion without qualification. Could be "非法行医". But the prosecution likely charges illegal fetal gender identification and illegal abortion (illegal family planning surgery). The rule says if multiple distinct criminal conduct, output all. So we have at least two.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法进行胎儿性别鉴定;非法进行节育手术<eoa>
